moments.title: European Athletics Championships Finals
moments.blurb: The European Athletics Championships continue in Birmingham, with the final events and medal ceremonies taking place this weekend, bringing world-class competition to the UK for the first time.

angles.name: Finals excitement
angles.copy: Who's watching the European Athletics Championships from Birmingham? It's the first time the UK has hosted, and the finals are happening this weekend! What a show! #EuroAthletics

angles.name: Home crowd roar
angles.copy: The Alexander Stadium in Birmingham is absolutely buzzing for the European Athletics Championships. That home crowd roar is something else! Get behind our athletes for the final push.

moments.title: Premier League Season Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season officially begins next Friday, August 21st, with champions Arsenal taking on newly promoted Coventry City.

angles.name: Anticipation
angles.copy: The wait is almost over! The Premier League returns next Friday, August 21st. Who are you backing for the title this season?

angles.name: First Match Focus
angles.copy: Arsenal kick off their title defence against Coventry City next Friday! Big start to the Premier League season. Where will you be watching?

moments.title: The Weeknd at Wembley Stadium
moments.blurb: The Weeknd continues his five-night residency at London's Wembley Stadium this week as part of his record-breaking After Hours Til Dawn Stadium Tour.

angles.name: Live at Wembley
angles.copy: The Weeknd is taking over Wembley Stadium this week! If you're heading to the After Hours Til Dawn tour, get ready for an epic show. What's your must-hear track?

angles.name: Tour success
angles.copy: From 'Blinding Lights' to 'Save Your Tears', The Weeknd's After Hours Til Dawn tour is making history. Catch him at Wembley if you can!

moments.title: Ariana Grande O2 Residency
moments.blurb: Ariana Grande kicks off her highly anticipated 10-night 'Eternal Sunshine Tour' residency at The O2 Arena in London tomorrow, marking her return to live performance.

angles.name: Ariana's return
angles.copy: The moment Arianators have been waiting for! Ariana Grande starts her epic 10-night residency at The O2 tomorrow. Who's got tickets to the 'Eternal Sunshine Tour'?

angles.name: London excitement
angles.copy: London is buzzing! Ariana Grande's 'Eternal Sunshine' tour begins its O2 residency tomorrow. Get ready for some major pop power in Greenwich!

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's Chart Record
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's collaboration 'Rein Me In' has achieved a record-breaking 21st week at Number 1 on the UK Singles Chart, becoming the longest-running chart-topper ever.

angles.name: Chart history
angles.copy: 21 weeks at Number 1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean have made history with 'Rein Me In' – the longest-running UK chart-topper EVER. Incredible achievement!

angles.name: British talent
angles.copy: British music making history! Sam Fender and Olivia Dean are still at #1 with 'Rein Me In'. That's a serious record for UK talent.

moments.title: Madonna & Kylie Minogue Top 10
moments.blurb: Pop icons Madonna and Kylie Minogue have debuted at Number 8 on the UK Singles Chart with their collaboration 'Love Sensation', extending Madonna's record for most Top 10 singles.

angles.name: Pop royalty
angles.copy: Queens of Pop unite! Madonna & Kylie Minogue are in the Top 10 with 'Love Sensation'. An iconic collaboration making chart history!

angles.name: Legendary collab
angles.copy: Madonna and Kylie in the charts together? Yes please! 'Love Sensation' proving these legends still got it. What a track!

moments.title: UK Heatwave Continues
moments.blurb: The UK is experiencing a prolonged heatwave, with temperatures reaching 38.1°C yesterday and forecasts predicting highs over 30°C in the south this weekend, alongside a significant dry spell.

angles.name: Stay cool
angles.copy: Another hot one across much of the UK today and into the weekend. Remember to stay hydrated and cool as the heatwave continues!

angles.name: Weekend forecast
angles.copy: Devon, it's set to be another sizzling weekend! Temperatures staying high, so make the most of the sunshine safely. Any plans for cooling off?

moments.title: Sarah Brightman's Birthday
moments.blurb: Today, August 14th, marks the 66th birthday of English classical crossover soprano and actress Sarah Brightman, known for her powerful vocals and stage performances.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Sarah
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 66th Birthday to the incredible Sarah Brightman today! What's your favourite song from the 'Phantom of the Opera' star?

angles.name: Vocal legend
angles.copy: Celebrating the birthday of the magnificent Sarah Brightman! Her voice is truly timeless. Raise a glass to 66 years of a vocal legend!

moments.title: Larry Graham's Birthday
moments.blurb: Funk pioneer and bassist Larry Graham, best known for his work with Sly and the Family Stone and Graham Central Station, turns 80 today, August 14th.

angles.name: Funk legend
angles.copy: Happy 80th Birthday to the one and only Larry Graham! The bass wizard behind Sly and the Family Stone and Graham Central Station. What a legend!

angles.name: Bass innovator
angles.copy: Celebrating the birthday of funk icon Larry Graham! His thumping basslines changed music forever. Here's to 80 years of groove!

moments.title: Ana Matronic's Birthday
moments.blurb: American singer and DJ Ana Matronic, best known as the lead vocalist for the Grammy-nominated band Scissor Sisters, celebrates her 52nd birthday today, August 14th.

angles.name: Scissor Sisters star
angles.copy: Happy 52nd Birthday to the fabulous Ana Matronic of Scissor Sisters! Get your dancing shoes on and celebrate with some classic tracks!

angles.name: Birthday groove
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy birthday to the incredible Ana Matronic! Her energy with Scissor Sisters is unmatched. Time to blast some 'Filthy/Gorgeous'!

moments.title: Mark Collins' Birthday
moments.blurb: Today, August 14th, marks the 61st birthday of English musician Mark Collins, renowned as the guitarist for Britpop band The Charlatans and later Starsailor.

angles.name: Britpop icon
angles.copy: Happy 61st Birthday to Mark Collins, guitar legend from The Charlatans! What's your favourite track from the Britpop era?

angles.name: Guitar hero
angles.copy: Celebrating Mark Collins' birthday today! From The Charlatans to Starsailor, his guitar work has defined some classic British tracks. Turn it up!

moments.title: Edinburgh Fringe Festival
moments.blurb: The world-renowned Edinburgh Fringe Festival is in full swing throughout August, offering thousands of comedy, theatre, music, and dance performances across the city.

angles.name: Fringe fun
angles.copy: Edinburgh is alive with the Fringe! So much incredible talent on display. What's the best show you've seen or heard about this year?

angles.name: Cultural highlight
angles.copy: From stand-up to street theatre, the Edinburgh Fringe Festival is a cultural explosion right now! Who's making the most of the performances?

moments.title: ArcTanGent Festival Begins
moments.blurb: The ArcTanGent Festival, known for its experimental rock and metal lineup, kicks off next Wednesday, August 19th, near Bristol.

angles.name: Festival countdown
angles.copy: Calling all rock and metal fans! ArcTanGent Festival starts next week. Who are you most excited to see on the lineup?

angles.name: Westcountry rock
angles.copy: Get ready, Westcountry! ArcTanGent brings the best in experimental rock and metal to Bristol next week. Sound good?

moments.title: Green Man Festival Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The independent Green Man Festival, celebrating music, arts, and culture, begins next Thursday, August 20th, in the Brecon Beacons, Wales.

angles.name: Welsh festival vibe
angles.copy: Green Man Festival starts next Thursday in the beautiful Brecon Beacons! Who's heading to Wales for a weekend of amazing music and arts?

angles.name: Counting down
angles.copy: Only a few days until Green Man Festival opens its gates! Get ready for incredible music and good vibes in the heart of Wales.

moments.title: We Out Here Festival Starts
moments.blurb: Gilles Peterson's award-winning We Out Here Festival, celebrating world-class music, wellness, and culture, commences next Thursday, August 20th, in Dorset.

angles.name: Sold out vibes
angles.copy: We Out Here Festival is SOLD OUT and kicks off next week in Dorset! Who's got tickets to Gilles Peterson's incredible celebration of music and culture?

angles.name: Dorset festival
angles.copy: The countdown is on for We Out Here Festival in Dorset! Get ready for a fantastic lineup of soul, hip hop, house, and jazz from next Thursday.

moments.title: REWIND Festival Henley
moments.blurb: The REWIND Festival, celebrating 80s music, takes place next weekend, August 21st-23rd, in Henley-On-Thames.

angles.name: 80s flashback
angles.copy: Dust off your leg warmers! REWIND Festival is back next weekend in Henley-On-Thames, bringing all the best 80s hits. Who's ready to party?

angles.name: Weekend of nostalgia
angles.copy: Get ready for a blast from the past! REWIND Festival is bringing the ultimate 80s party to Henley next weekend. Which classic act are you hoping to see?

moments.title: Trentham Live Festival
moments.blurb: Trentham Live, a series of outdoor concerts featuring popular artists, runs next week from August 20th to 23rd in Staffordshire.

angles.name: Midlands music
angles.copy: Trentham Live kicks off next week in Staffordshire! Who are you excited to see perform at this fantastic outdoor concert series?

angles.name: Summer concerts
angles.copy: Enjoying the last of the summer concerts? Trentham Live brings more great artists to Staffordshire next week! Perfect for a warm evening.

moments.title: Palace Bowl Presents Series Nears End
moments.blurb: The 'Palace Bowl Presents' festival series at Crystal Palace Bowl in London concludes this Sunday, August 16th, featuring an eclectic lineup of global headliners.

angles.name: Last chance London
angles.copy: Catch the final acts at Palace Bowl Presents this weekend! It's been an amazing summer of music at Crystal Palace Bowl. Don't miss out!

angles.name: Summer series finale
angles.copy: The Palace Bowl Presents series wraps up this Sunday! Get down to Crystal Palace for one last summer musical hurrah. Who's playing?

moments.title: Sports Fest 2026 in London
moments.blurb: Sports Fest 2026 takes place tomorrow, Saturday August 15th, at Kensington Gardens in London, offering a day of fun, fitness, and community activities including football and rounders.

angles.name: Get active London
angles.copy: Looking for something active to do tomorrow? Sports Fest 2026 is on in Kensington Gardens! Football, rounders, and fun for everyone.

angles.name: Community sport
angles.copy: Sports Fest 2026 is happening tomorrow! A great chance to get out, get active, and join in some community fun in Kensington Gardens.

moments.title: Summer Nights at the Bandstand Ends
moments.blurb: The 'Summer Nights at the Bandstand' concert series in Glasgow concludes this Sunday, August 15th, after a run of performances throughout July and August.

angles.name: Glasgow farewell
angles.copy: Last chance to catch Summer Nights at the Bandstand in Glasgow this weekend! It's been a fantastic series of gigs. Who did you see perform?

angles.name: Summer concert close
angles.copy: The Summer Nights at the Bandstand series wraps up this Sunday. Great music, great atmosphere. Sad to see it go!
